memory.basis: issuer local measurement, peak 408 MB, 70 percent rule

words: The root declares, in its own state, one report-build function through the yang-lambda module (handler lambda_handler, python3.12, timeout 900 seconds, memory 1024 MB, the existing native layer through a read-only data source, no reserved concurrency, no environment variable, the artifact key read from the source map by the builder name), its execution role and policy with seven explicit statements and no wildcard or all-resources grant, its scheduler role and policy with one statement, and one schedule created DISABLED at 09:15 on weekdays in America/New_York. The six names come from the opal_name builder, and the firm, the gold bucket and the served object are derived from the declaration, the registry and the adapter constants. The three checks proved: the HCL clause (AC1) holds on the five files; the real naming gate in plan mode grades the six named resources CONFORMANT, the layer holds pyarrow, the bundle imports only pyarrow and the runtime's modules, and the build-only package of 19 members equals its sources byte for byte (AC2); and the source-map entry is new, with 18 members pinned to ancestor commits whose sha256 equals the file at HEAD (AC3). Not proven: no terraform plan, no apply, no invoke, no deploy, and nothing about the Lambda runtime's memory or run time.
